workLog.entry: Reviewed the full #2840 discourse and ADR-080. Found local main 101 commits behind origin; ADR-080 governance check, baseline, and manifest already shipped in #3071. Branched feat/2840-model-pin-migration from fresh origin/main.

Ground-truthed the state: baseline 113 grandfathered pins, warn mode wired into pre_pr, manifest empty. Confirmed the check contract: skills/commands may not carry a versioned id; a bare alias is legal only when it prices below the default (haiku only).

De-versioned 66 skills + 1 command via a scripted frontmatter transform: sonnet/opus versioned ids removed (inherit); haiku ids converted to bare alias plus a cost model-rationale. Excluded 8 skills whose pre-existing structural or em-dash debt the per-file validators surfaced on touch (out of #2840 scope); they keep their pins and stay grandfathered.

Regenerated the Copilot skill mirrors (build_all): 73 mirrors updated (merge-resolver correctly omitted from the ship set). Closed the regrowth sources: SkillForge skill-md-template, output-structure examples, github/fix-ci pin, and the .claude/skills/CLAUDE.md model-selection guidance.

Taught the SkillForge validator the model-rationale property (_constants.py, per ADR-080 point 4) so the haiku alias skills validate. Drained the baseline 113 to 52 (frozen_count 52) and reran the check: warn OK, enforce exit 0, 31 tests green. Confirmed agent_registry.py requires model on agents, which is why the agent half stays owner-gated (removing agent pins breaks validation; keeping them fails the alias rule).

nextSteps: Owner decision A: reconcile ADR-080 step 2b (generator must stop injecting model) against ADR-002 and templates.md MUST-4/5 and agent_registry required model field. The three disagree; agents cannot both drop the pin and pass validation.
Owner decision B: authorize eval API spend to sweep the ~17 fixture-backed agents (KEEP_PIN over >= 8 fixtures records a manifest entry; DROP_PIN or no fixtures removes the pin).

De-version the 8 skills excluded here once their pre-existing debt is fixed (structural: analysis-provenance, avoiding-manufactured-work, encode-repo-serena, taste-lints, observability, fix-markdown-fences; em-dash: negotiation, pipeline-validator). This is #2993-class latent-debt-on-touch, not #2840.
After A and B, migrate the remaining agent/command pins, drain the baseline to empty, and flip check_model_pins to enforce.
